hauptbahnhof.description: Glass and steel main station hall beside the viaduct, 8 × 44 m, 19 m tall; front (+x) toward the track, door at the back

altbau-16.description: Gründerzeit tenement, 13 × 16 m, five storeys and a mansard roof; front (+x) to the street

altbau-20.description: Gründerzeit tenement, 13 × 20 m, five storeys and a mansard roof; front (+x) to the street

altbau-24.description: Gründerzeit tenement, 13 × 24 m, five storeys and a mansard roof; front (+x) to the street

altbau-20-hoch.description: Gründerzeit tenement, 13 × 20 m, six storeys and a mansard roof; front (+x) to the street

altbau-24-niedrig.description: Gründerzeit tenement, 13 × 24 m, four storeys and a mansard roof; front (+x) to the street

altbau-eck.description: Gründerzeit tenement, 13 × 20 m, five storeys and a mansard roof; front (+x) to the street, corner turret

altbau-eck-r.description: Gründerzeit tenement, 13 × 20 m, five storeys and a mansard roof; front (+x) to the street, corner turret

altbau-laden.description: Gründerzeit tenement, 13 × 20 m, five storeys and a mansard roof; front (+x) to the street, shop on the ground floor

plattenbau.description: Prefabricated slab block (Plattenbau), 12 × 60 m, 11 storeys; entrances on the front (+x)

plattenbau-kurz.description: Prefabricated slab block (Plattenbau), 12 × 36 m, 6 storeys; entrances on the front (+x)

punkthochhaus.description: Prefab point tower, 18 × 18 m, 21 storeys; entrance on the front (+x)

fernsehturm.description: Television tower, 160 m: a tapering concrete shaft, a steel sphere with a revolving restaurant, a red and white antenna; pavilion at its foot, entrance on the front (+x)

dom.description: Cathedral with a great copper dome, four corner towers and a columned portico; portico and doors on the front (+x)

rathaus.description: Red brick town hall, 36 × 60 m, four storeys round a courtyard, with a clock tower over the entrance on the front (+x)

brandenburger-tor.description: Sandstone city gate, 40 m wide: twelve Doric columns, an attic and a quadriga on top; the passages run along x

siegessaeule.description: Victory column, 65 m: granite base, a columned hall, a sandstone shaft with gilded rings and a golden Victoria on top

museum.description: Classical museum, 24 × 60 m, a long colonnade of eighteen columns along its front (+x) and a dome behind the attic

backsteinkirche.description: Red brick neo-Gothic church, 34 × 16 m nave with a tall west tower and a green copper spire; the tower end is the front (+x)

wasserturm.description: Round brick water tower with flats inside, 20 m across, 30 m tall, conical slate roof and lantern; door on the front (+x)

markthalle.description: Brick market hall, 30 × 44 m, glazed roof lantern, big arched entrance on the front (+x)

brauerei.description: Brick brewery yard with a brewhouse tower and chimney, 30 × 50 m; gate on the front (+x)

schule.description: Brick school, 14 × 48 m, three storeys and a hipped roof; entrance on the front (+x)

hochhaus.description: Glass office tower, 24 × 30 m, 82 m tall, on a two-storey podium; entrance on the front (+x)

speicher.description: Brick harbour warehouse, 16 × 36 m, five storeys of loading doors under a gable roof; front (+x) to the street

gasometer.description: Gas holder: a steel drum inside a 46 m lattice frame of columns; gate on the front (+x)

kraftwerk.description: Brick power station, 34 × 46 m: turbine hall, boiler house and three tall chimneys; burns coal; entrance on the front (+x)

kran.description: Harbour portal crane, 8 m gauge, 24 m tall, with its jib reaching out over the water to the front (+x)

denkmal.description: Cast-iron Gothic monument, 20 m: a spire of pinnacles on a cross-shaped stone base

werkhalle.description: Brick factory hall, 26 × 60 m, a sawtooth roof of six north lights, tall windows and a chimney; gate on the front (+x)

kaufhalle.description: Single-storey supermarket of the 1970s, 24 × 36 m, a glazed shop front and a flat roof; entrance on the front (+x)

spaeti.description: Späti: a little corner kiosk, 3 × 4 m, open counter and drinks crates on the front (+x)

imbiss.description: Currywurst stand, 3 × 5 m, a hatch and a little awning on the front (+x)

litfasssaeule.description: Advertising column, 1.1 m across, 3.6 m tall, pasted with posters; small enough to stand on a pavement

gaslaterne.description: Old Berlin gas street lamp, 4.8 m, a lantern on a slender green post; lit at night

laube.description: Allotment garden shed, 3 × 4 m, painted boards and a gable roof

pflaster.description: 5 × 5 m of granite paving, 0.2 m proud of the ground (lay many for a square)

brunnen.description: Fountain: a round granite basin 18 m across with a figure group in the middle

weltzeituhr.description: World clock: a drum of time zones on a column with a little planetary sculpture on top, 10 m

doppeldecker.description: Yellow double-decker bus, 11.4 m long, 4.3 m tall; windows lit at night

trabant.description: Little two-stroke saloon, 3.6 m long; headlights glow at night

reichstag.description: Parliament building, 60 × 42 m, four corner towers and a glass dome; the columned portico faces the front (+x)

stelenfeld.description: Field of grey concrete stelae on a 30 × 40 m grid, of differing heights (a memorial); walk in from any side

mauer.description: 30 m of the Berlin Wall: grey concrete L-segments with the round pipe on top, along y; the front (+x) is the former west side

mauer-bunt.description: 30 m of the Berlin Wall painted in bright murals (East Side Gallery), along y; the paintings face the front (+x)

wachturm.description: Border watchtower, 10 m: a slim concrete shaft under an octagonal lookout with windows all round

schloss.description: Baroque palace, 44 × 64 m, three storeys round a courtyard with a copper dome over the west portal; front (+x)

konzerthaus.description: Neoclassical concert hall, 32 × 50 m, with a temple portico and steps on the front (+x)

synagoge.description: Synagogue front, 24 × 30 m, with a gilded ribbed dome and two small domed towers; the doors face the front (+x)

philharmonie.description: Concert hall with a tent-like golden roof, 46 × 54 m, entrance on the front (+x)

nationalgalerie.description: Gallery pavilion: a black steel roof 50 m square floating over a glass hall, on a granite terrace; entrance on the front (+x)

portikus.description: Ruined station portico: a brick front 34 m wide with a tall arched gateway and nothing behind; the arch faces the front (+x)

checkpoint.description: Border checkpoint: a small white booth among sandbags with a sign, 5 × 4 m; front (+x)

technikmuseum.description: Museum of technology, 30 × 40 m, glass and brick, with a twin-engined transport plane on the roof; entrance on the front (+x)

kma-block.description: Karl-Marx-Allee block of flats, 14 × 60 m, nine storeys of pale tiles with a colonnaded shop floor and corniced roof; front (+x)

torturm.description: Tower block on a square, 18 × 18 m, thirteen storeys, crowned by a tall domed rotunda; front (+x)

kanzleramt.description: Chancellery: a white cube 36 m wide and 30 m tall with a great round window, low wings either side; front (+x)

arena.description: Event arena, 50 × 70 m: a low hall with a glass front and a curved roof; entrance on the front (+x)

buero.description: Glass office block, 16 × 30 m, eight storeys with a recessed top floor; entrance on the front (+x)

u-eingang.description: U-Bahn entrance, 2 × 7 m: a glass canopy over the stairs with a blue U sign; the platform is in front (+x), the street door at the back

s-eingang.description: S-Bahn entrance, 3 × 9 m: a small brick hall under the viaduct with a green S sign; the platform is in front (+x), the street door at the back
